purpose: Turn Sheikha Knowledge, Architecture Intelligence, Editor Core, and Operation Loop from definition layers into a governed execution fabric that scans, analyzes, reports, indexes, and updates knowledge artifacts.

engines.name: knowledge_scanner
engines.purpose: Scan knowledge, governance, reports, decisions, lessons, and roadmap artifacts.

engines.name: pr_scanner
engines.purpose: Scan PR governance records, review decisions, curated merge plans, blockers, and required actions.

engines.name: architecture_scanner
engines.purpose: Scan Fabric routes, runtime definitions, route modules, governance layers, and architecture intelligence artifacts.

engines.name: runtime_scanner
engines.purpose: Scan runtime directories, route surfaces, tools, reports, and generated operational outputs.

engines.name: roadmap_generator
engines.purpose: Generate next-step roadmap items from scan findings and governance blockers.

engines.name: report_generator
engines.purpose: Generate detailed JSON and Markdown reports for human review.

engines.name: decision_registry
engines.purpose: Register decisions with stable IDs and evidence paths.

engines.name: lessons_learned_generator
engines.purpose: Generate lessons learned without self-modifying the runtime.
